eventName: F1 Mobility Resort Motegi category reference

qualifying.selectedMethod: Category target window midpoint, cross-checked against the 2026 SUPER FORMULA reference at the same course

sources.label: SUPER FORMULA Motegi Round 2 official result
Mobility Resort Motegi road course

notes: F1 has never run this circuit, so no F1 timing exists for it. The baseline is a project target window for the F1 category on this course, not an observed result.

Cross-check: the 2026 SUPER FORMULA qualifying reference here is 90.369s, so this baseline puts F1 at 95.2% of Super Formula lap time. Suzuka, the only course both categories run in 2026, measures 91.3%.
Course-level by design: rounds at the same circuit share this record, and the Super Formula baseline for the same circuit stays separate.
